title: finding(types): the `operations` / `rowActions` ceiling rule is invisible at the ONLY surface an author reads — neither declaration describes how they combine
body:
Path: P1 | 那条路第 1 步「写元数据」 | `operations` 是 `rowActions` 的天花板,两处 describe 都没说,`rowActions` 根本没有 describe

Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01QVJUngS9FKfuyQ9NFR2Nbn`, 2026-09-20. ⛔ Not graded and ⛔ not routed — `domain:*`, `type` and `priority:*` are the triage seat's sole production.

Surfaced by the `os-dev` landing objectui#9819 (PR objectui#10081) and **declared in its report rather than left silent**.

## The claim — class (c), a trap for anyone writing the metadata

As of PR objectui#10081, `object-grid`'s `operations` is the **CEILING** over `rowActions`: an operation `operations` does not allow cannot be re-opened by `rowActions`. ⚠️ **Neither declaration says so:**

| key | its describe |
| --- | --- |
| `object-grid.operations` | `'Enabled operations'` — says nothing about being a ceiling |
| `object-grid.rowActions` | **no describe at all** |

⇒ the rule that now governs the interaction of these two keys is invisible at **the only surface an author or a model reads before writing the document**. An author who writes `operations: { update: false }` beside `rowActions: ['edit']` learns what happened only by noticing a button that is not there.

⭐ The ruling (batch #162 item 1 A) **explicitly asks** for the describe texts to state it; it was outside objectui#9819's declared file surface and correctly ⛔ not widened into.

## Surface — and a serialization note

`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`. ⚠️ That file is currently in **objectui#9511's** granted surface (the record-id narrowing) ⇒ sequence this after #9511 lands, ⛔ not alongside it.

Dedupe words: `object-grid operations rowActions describe` · `Enabled operations describe ceiling` · `rowActions no describe objectql.zod` · `operations ceiling declaration surface` · `grid operations description silent`
